Data Governance and Data Quality Analyst with 6+ years of experience in financial services, specializing in data governance frameworks, data quality controls, metadata management, and stakeholder collaboration. Proven ability to translate business requirements into structured data solutions, support data catalog initiatives, and drive adoption through documentation, training, and governance standards.
